item.title: Assisting and protecting the most vulnerable migrants in West Africa (2020-2023).
item.dc:creator: concideas.com
item.description: A multi-year regional programme funded by the EUTF. The programme has been implementing a route-based migration approach with National Societies in Burkina Faso, the Gambia, Mali, Niger and Senegal, supported by the Spanish Red Cross and the Danish Red Cross.
